messages:
maria.partnerships: Partners (Snowflake, Databricks, Qdrant) proposed a coordinated marketplace listing + joint PR in mid-Sept. They want a single embargo window and aligned staging tests. Need compact preflight: legal/DPA, embargo time, staging creds, ingest method, telemetry quotas, marketplace manifest + SKU. Who owns embargo coordination?

sam.eng: I can own infra. Can provision staging by 2024-09-10. Clarify ingest: partners upload to S3 or use our uploader? Recommend demo throttling: 200rps baseline, allow spikes with auto-throttle.

jordan-partner: From Qdrant side we'll push a 10GB vector snapshot to S3; need presigned link + schema. We can convert to smaller synthetic set if needed for legal.

leo-pm: Marketing prefers Sept 16 for embargo lift. That gives partners Mon for last checks.

natalie-legal: Need to review sample data for PII and retention. If partners provide synthetic data approvals faster. EU listings require signed DPA before public launch.

amy-marketing: Proposed embargo: 2024-09-16 09:00 PT. I need partner-approved logos and a short product sentence by Thursday. I'll prepare PR draft and upload to shared drive.

deploy-bot: staging cluster provisioned: redwood-staging-398765 (owner: sam.eng). Temporary creds posted to #secrets (auto-delete 7d).

sam.eng: Telemetry caps: default 1k reqs/s, demo rule 200rps steady per partner, burst to 1k for scheduled tests. Manifest must include telemetry endpoint and quota fields. @maria.partnerships share expected concurrency per partner.

maria.partnerships: Partners estimate ~200rps each; hardware partner might spike to 1k during throughput demo. We'll ask them to gate spikes; eng will enable auto-throttle fallback.

leo-pm: Runbook items: Legal sign-off, staging creds & ingest path, telemetry caps & alerts, connector manifest + SKU, press embargo & assets, go/no-go 24h prior.

natalie-legal: I'll review redaction & DPA by EOD Friday; synthetic data speeds approval. If partners delay, EU region listing blocked.

amy-marketing: Uploaded PR draft link. Need final SKU and pricing tier for marketplace listing.

sam.eng: Example manifest snippet to include in listing: name, version, regions, supported_hardware, telemetry_endpoint, support_contact. I'll paste a sample in the drive.

maria.partnerships: Sending calendar invite for Thurs 10:00am PT to lock embargo and checklist. Will collect logos + partner confirmations before the meeting.

jordan-partner: Qdrant will prepare a synthetic 2GB sample and send DPA routing info today.

leo-pm: Thanks team. See you Thurs 10am PT.

maria.partnerships: I'll update thread with any partner replies and the invite.
